jsonld_raw.name: CHAOTIC BERRIES SHIMMERING BODY OIL 100 ML (3.4 FL. OZ).
jsonld_raw.description:
CHAOTIC BERRIES SHIMMERING BODY OIL 100 ML (3.4 FL. OZ). The iconic Chaotic Berries fragrance in Shimmering Body Oil format combines a luminous glow with its unmistakable scent trail to enhance the olfactory experience. Strawberry provides a juicy and vibrant opening that melts with the enveloping sweetness of maple syrup. Leather introduces an unexpected depth that adds character and contrast, creating a modern and deliciously addictive fragrance.

Fruity woody | Juicy, intense and bold.
